hypotheses.reasoning: At 12:03:10 template-svc reloaded MAILER_API_KEY from the secrets store as version 17, and version 16 was revoked (#114). Starting at 12:04:07, every send to the email provider from template-svc is rejected with 401 Unauthorized, invalid API key (#117, #122, #128). This is the originating fault: a rotated credential that the service picked up while the old key was revoked. template-svc's failed renders then return 502 to notification-svc (#130, #146), and notification-svc returns 502 to api-gateway, which produces the 502 alert on POST /v1/notify (#121, #139, #144, #157). The gateway, notification-svc and template-svc 5xx lines are downstream symptoms and are not cited. The 429 throttling on k-2741 (#19) is unrelated. notif-db, redis and notif-worker logged no errors, so they are not implicated.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll template-svc's MAILER_API_KEY back to version 16, or install a valid active key version. Confirm that version 17 is valid with the mailer provider. Reload template-svc and verify that renders succeed and the 502 rate on /v1/notify drops. Add an alert on 401s from the email provider, and do not revoke the previous key until every consumer has switched to the new one.
